skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand short, simple conversations and announcements in everyday contexts.
Communicate basic information about oneself and others in simple everyday situations.
Read and understand short, simple texts in everyday contexts.
Write short, simple texts about oneself and others in everyday contexts.
Develop independent learning skills for vocabulary acquisition and grammar practice.
Complete online assignments to reinforce classroom learning.
Engage in self-study and practice pronunciation, sentence formation, and writing.
Use digital tools and platforms for language learning and practice.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and prepare for assessments.
Participate in group discussions and activities to enhance language skills.
Apply critical thinking to understand and use language in various contexts.
Communicate effectively in French in a variety of everyday situations.
Understand and apply basic French grammar rules.
Acquire and use a basic French vocabulary in everyday contexts.
Achieve A1 level proficiency in French according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
